items.title: Moldova reportedly seeks to retain selected CIS agreements
items.summary: CIS Secretary-General Sergei Lebedev said Moldova is negotiating to preserve certain agreements as it moves toward withdrawing from the Commonwealth of Independent States. He argued that withdrawal would be detrimental to Moldova.

items.title: Ukraine reportedly renames most streets associated with Russia and the Soviet Union
items.summary: Russian media reported that Ukraine has renamed 96% of streets associated with Russia and the Soviet Union since 2022 as part of its decommunization efforts. The figure has not been independently verified.
